profile.reading: Brand first then function/form, in French with heavy abbreviations: BAD for toothbrushes, BIB/BIBERON, DENT for toothpaste, SHAMP, CREM/CREME, GEL, LOTION. Sizes are volumes and masses 15 ML to 600 ML, 25 G to 400 GR, dosages 0.05%, 400MG, 1000MG, bandage dimensions 4M X 10 CM with order varying. Packs decide variants: B/10, B/20, B/30, B/100, P/30, C/120, CP/COMP/CAPS/SACHET/AMP. What tells two products of one brand apart is dosage, volume/mass, dimension, pack count, plus colour, flavour and size for toothbrushes, condoms, baby bottles.
